name: n8n-nodes-decision-matrix
description: n8n community node that runs a declarative decision matrix against any System One / Jev-compatible server

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && tsc -b packages/decision-matrix-rules packages/decision-matrix-systemone packages/decision-matrix-cli && node scripts/bundle-node.js && node scripts/copy-assets.js
scripts.test: tsx --test tests/rules-engine.test.ts tests/facts.test.ts tests/policy.test.ts tests/normalize.test.ts tests/parameters.test.ts tests/workflows.test.ts tests/cli.test.ts
scripts.typecheck: tsc -b packages/decision-matrix-rules packages/decision-matrix-systemone packages/decision-matrix-cli --pretty false && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
